sections.voiceover: The mysterious Havana Syndrome weapon persisted for 9 years before investigators finally uncovered the truth.

sections.voiceover: In October 2026, journalists Michael Rey and Oriana Zill de Granados revealed new evidence about anomalous health incidents. Investigative partners at The Insider and 60 Minutes uncovered Russian links. Where did the secret device come from?
sections.visual_cue: Medium shot of a journalist reviewing investigation notes and reports.
sections.sfx_cue: Subtle paper shuffle and soft room tone.

sections.voiceover: Except the Defense Department spent more than a year testing a recovered device.
sections.visual_cue: Close up shot of a specialized testing laboratory environment.

sections.voiceover: Homeland Security Investigations purchased the hardware in an undercover operation. Russia directed GRU Unit 29155 to deploy the directed energy weapons against diplomats. Former National Security Advisor John Bolton confirmed the failure.
sections.visual_cue: Wide shot of a government conference room with classified briefing monitors.
sections.sfx_cue: Deep bass impact on the revelation.
sections.animation_cue: Subtle push forward on the briefing room.

sections.voiceover: The 9 years of mystery ended with verified state involvement.
sections.visual_cue: Close up of an investigative report final page being stamped classified.
sections.sfx_cue: Stamp sound effect ending on silence.
